اشتغلت (form VIII)

# اِشْتَغَلْتَ (ištaḡalta) /iʃ.ta.ɣal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
# اِشْتَغَلْتِ (ištaḡalti) /iʃ.ta.ɣal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
# اِشْتَغَلَتْ (ištaḡalat) /iʃ.ta.ɣa.lat/: third-perso
